terminus.method: counterexample-driven revision of activation-capacity feedback model
terminus.sourceSays: The Lee Tung Street movement developed residents' planning knowledge, communication skills, public participation capacity and transferable movement experience. Yet as residents were displaced, regular local participation shrank sharply and the original preservation objective ultimately failed; the organization later persisted in a more professionalized civic-education form.
terminus.mutherGenerated: Participation can reproduce capacity while simultaneously depleting the local carrier base that originally sustained it. Capacity therefore has at least two scales: local embedded capacity and transferable field/network capacity. A failed local struggle can destroy the first while strengthening the second. New candidate model: activation capacity does not simply grow or decay; it can migrate across scale and carrier.
terminus.novelty: YES · adds a scale/carrier dimension rather than merely restating participation-as-learning
terminus.counterexample: Repeated participation did not preserve the local resident base; displacement reduced attendance from near one hundred active participants at peak to roughly ten core members, while organizational knowledge survived and was transferred elsewhere.
terminus.repeatability: needs test in a non-urban-movement domain
